description: We use the CICE Consortium model which simulates sea-ice dynamics and thermodynamics and includes a subgridscale ice thickness distribution (ITD). For CESM3-CICE6 we use the most of the defaults from the CICE Consortium. The main differences in the CESM3-CICE6 include: sea-level ponds (Clemens-Sewall et al. in prep), floe size distribution with new wave fracturing (Tremblay and Roach 2026), and the one-step congelation growth of Plante et al. 2024. The following are the namelist changes from the standard CICE configuration:  ``` congel_freeze = 'one-step' tr_ponds_sealvl = .true. tscale_pnd_drain = 0.5 wave_frac_spec = 'alt' (not yet in the Consortium code) ```
